visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of three skeins of cream-colored yarn with white and black labels reading 'PLATEAU'. A hand enters the frame to hold one of the skeins. The lighting is bright and natural. (2) The scene shifts to a woman with long dark hair wearing a grey sweatshirt and grey sweatpants. She is sitting on a light-colored wooden floor in a living room, surrounded by a massive tangle of thin white yarn. The yarn is wrapped around her feet and legs. (3) A fast-paced montage follows, showing her in various positions—lying down, sitting, and leaning against a sofa—as she meticulously untangles the yarn. She holds a growing ball of yarn in one hand. The background shows bookshelves and various household items in a well-lit, spacious room. (4) The woman is shown winding the yarn by hand, and then a young girl in beige pajamas appears, clapping her hands excitedly as they celebrate the completion of a ball of yarn. (5) A close-up shows the woman holding a small, tightly wound ball of yarn near her face. (6) The video transitions to her using a pink mechanical yarn winder. She holds a large loop of yarn around her arm, pulling it as the machine spins. A man is visible in the background, sitting at a table. (7) The woman stands in a high-ceilinged room with large windows, looping a long stretch of yarn around her arm and a flat board in a repetitive, rhythmic motion, resembling the pulling of noodles. A large stack of books tied with red string sits in the foreground.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 買了三捆線. (2) [Subtitle]: 沒想到是 自找麻煩的開始. (3) [Subtitle]: 線拆開沒多久 它就瘋狂的打結. (4) [Subtitle]: 然後我就陷入 拆結地獄裡. (5) [Subtitle]: 越拆我就越不想放棄 但是看著時間 一點一點的流逝. (6) [Subtitle]: 不知不覺 我還有好長好長 的線要拆啊. (7) [Subtitle]: 拆結這件事 真是令人崩潰 卻又療癒. (8) [Subtitle]: 可以專注的 做一件事情 躺著、坐著、站著. (9) [Subtitle]: 最後我一共花了 將近5個多小時. (10) [Subtitle]: 才把那一捆 400多公分的線 通通都解開了. (11) [Variety]: 居然才這麼一小顆. (12) [Subtitle]: 再用捲線器 把它捲整齊 我真的是自找麻煩. (13) [Subtitle]: 後來找到 一個好方法 看起來很蠢 但是它的確不會打結. (14) [Subtitle]: 小莉說鄰居會以為我在 拉麵.
